entries.name: Afeni Shakur

expected_cases.charges: Conspiracy to bomb New York City police stations, a railroad station, and Manhattan department stores (Panther 21 prosecution)
expected_cases.sentence: Initial Panther 21 pretrial detention ended with release on bail January 30, 1970. Later remand beginning February 8, 1971 was a separate custody period. Acquitted May 13, 1971.

case.charges: Panther 21 conspiracy prosecution: separate remand after revocation of bail
case.sentence: Returned to custody February 8, 1971 after bail was revoked. Released May 3, 1971 pending the verdict; acquitted May 13. This remand is separate from the initial April 1969-January 1970 detention and excludes the intervening period on bail.

entries.rationale: Contemporaneous judicial opinion dates remand February 8, overriding February 3 in secondary histories. Authorized biography pp17/21 confirms February 8 and May 3 actual departure home; May14 Militant contemporaneous report corroborates May3 release before acquittal. No duplicate counting of the bail gap.
